title: 第150章 葬土再立大功墟丹开天神魔经第149章 入侵这我熟啊
content_zh:
第150章葬土再立大功，《墟丹开天神魔经》
归墟禁地是一个十分特殊的地方。
它是目前已知，唯一从上古时期就遗留下来的遗迹。
关于这地方的记载，各说纷纭。
李青山的师父，也提及过一些关于这里的信息。
今个却是李青山第一次亲自踏足这片地界。
怎么说呢。
和书中记载的一般无二，也和他想象之中的不一样。
不甘中却又有些平静的声音，最终从千尘嘴巴里缓缓蠕而最为恐怖的是，这家伙不仅出手力道大，招式连贯性也是不俗，刚才仅仅数息间，就连续发动了三轮攻势，行云流水，但是被王破给挡下来了。
她发现自己的父亲已经变了，变得如此的陌生，甚至连自己都感觉到了可怕。
虽然都是将灵力在奇经八脉中流转，但不同的功法，流动的路径并不相同，对于修炼的影响，效果也大不一样。
张伏虎仔细的分析道：“两位弟弟的品性，父亲难道还不知，若非即将回来，也不会提前写信告诉父亲他们的近况。我在想，其一，他们是要让父亲以为不打算马上回来，所以先写一封家信报个平安，让您老人家先放心的。
叶建出声道，按照现在的情况来看，恐怕在叶宗生死未明之前，叶家也只能让他们三个兄弟接手了，只是叶宗也无辜消失，要怎么圆这个谎呢。
还好夏枫只是拥着她入睡，没有任何其它过激的行为，这让她的心情又有些复杂，是我魅力不够还是什么？
而且他的手上还制住一位黑衣人，黑衣人的一只手已经被格桑生生掰断，此时正痛苦的呆在格桑的手臂下。
扫了几眼后，是越看越看不下去，这地方简直成了杀猪场。除了血腥还是血腥，碎肉碎骨头满地都死，那感觉比吃了只苍蝇还恶心。
但吴风咬牙坚挺着，心中暗忖：我身上也只是单薄的衣裳，虽为男儿身尚且忍受不住，她一个姑娘家如何受得了这般寒风侵体。
再之后陆续有过两次，最严重的这次，是年后在家看电视，看了个煽情的寻亲节目，午睡起来以后，忽然拿菜刀要砍人，她说要砍死自己的父母。
而在这些至宝消失的那一刹那，那些人形的虚影，彻底的变的凝实，也就彻底的代表着，最强天劫，在历经万年之后，第一次，降临在了这个时间。
就在两人谈笑风生的时候，那一直漂浮在半空之中的凌云第一神器凌云棋魂突然紫光大闪。

雪丽一颗心高高的提起，双手紧握在一起，下意识的看了眼四周。
对方或许并不可怕，但是两大天帝强者在同一时空相遇所引发的天罚将会比天帝遇古帝恐怖十万倍，这样的天罚即便是天帝强者也难以承受。
这两年，经常干活的时候，慕容曦时不时地会过来捣乱，慕容云裳练就了雷厉风行的效率，也练就了哄人的本事，开口，她也是自然而然地像是在哄淘气的慕容曦一样。
content_en:
Chapter 150: The burial soil makes great achievements again, "Xu Dan Kai Tian Shen Demon Sutra"
The Guixu Forbidden Land is a very special place.
It is the only known relic left from ancient times.
There are different opinions about this place.
Li Qingshan's master also mentioned some information about this place.
This is the first time Li Qingshan has set foot in this area in person.
How to say it.
It was the same as what was recorded in the book, but also different from what he imagined.
A reluctant but somewhat calm voice finally slowly crawled out of Qian Chen's mouth. The most terrifying thing was that this guy was not only powerful in his attacks, but also had good consistency in his moves. In just a few breaths, he launched three consecutive rounds of attacks, smoothly and smoothly, but was blocked by Wang Po.
She found that her father had changed and became so strange that even she felt frightened.
Although they all flow spiritual power through the eight extraordinary meridians, different techniques have different flow paths, and their effects on cultivation are also very different.
Zhang Fuhu analyzed carefully: "Doesn't father still know the character of the two younger brothers? If he hadn't come back soon, he wouldn't have written to tell father in advance about their current situation. I'm thinking, first, they want to make father think that they don't plan to come back soon, so they wrote a letter home to say that they are safe first, so that you can rest assured first.
Ye Jian said, judging from the current situation, I am afraid that before Ye Zong's life and death are unknown, the Ye family can only let the three brothers take over. However, Ye Zong also disappeared innocently, how can we fulfill this lie.
Fortunately, Xia Feng just hugged her and fell asleep without any other extreme behavior. This made her mood a little complicated. Am I not charming enough or something?
Moreover, he also restrained a man in black with his hand. One of the man's hands had been broken off by Gesang, and he was currently in pain under Gesang's arm.
After taking a few glances, the more I looked at it, the less I could stand it. This place had simply become a pig-killing farm. In addition to being bloody, there were broken pieces of meat and bones all over the floor. It felt more disgusting than eating a fly.
But Wu Feng gritted his teeth and thought to himself: I only have thin clothes on my body. Although I am a man, I can't bear it. How can a girl like her endure such a cold wind?
It happened twice after that. The most serious one happened after the New Year. She was watching TV at home and watched a sensational family-finding program. After getting up from a nap, she suddenly took a kitchen knife and wanted to kill someone. She said she wanted to kill her parents.
And at the moment when these treasures disappeared, those human-shaped shadows completely became solid, which completely represented that the most powerful disaster, after thousands of years, came at this time for the first time.
Just as the two were chatting and laughing, Lingyun's first artifact, the Lingyun Chess Soul, which had been floating in the air, suddenly flashed with purple light.
Xue Li's heart was lifted high, her hands were clasped together, and she glanced around subconsciously.
The opponent may not be terrible, but the punishment caused by the two powerful Heavenly Emperors meeting in the same time and space will be a hundred thousand times more terrifying than when the Heavenly Emperor meets the Ancient Emperor. Even the powerful Heavenly Emperor cannot bear such a punishment.
In the past two years, when she was often working, Murong Xi would come over to cause trouble from time to time. Murong Yunshang had developed her resolute efficiency and the ability to coax people. When she spoke, she would naturally act like she was coaxing the naughty Murong Xi.
